title: Thunderbird freezes after startup. I tried restarting, Troubleshoot Mode, and both “default” and “default-esr” profiles, but the issue remains. Please advise how to fix this without losing my emails. This is affecting my work and needs urgent resolution.
creator: t.saito3
content:
Additional details:

  • Operating system: Windows (please specify your Windows version if known)
  • The issue started on August 25, 2026.
  • Thunderbird becomes unresponsive shortly after startup.
  • A “System Integration” prompt appears before Thunderbird becomes unresponsive.
  • I cannot click any buttons once Thunderbird becomes unresponsive.
  • I tested both available profiles (“default” and “default-esr”) using the Profile Manager, but the same issue occurred with both profiles.
  • I also started Thunderbird in Troubleshoot Mode with all add-ons disabled, but the issue still occurred.
  • I can force-close Thunderbird through Windows when it becomes unresponsive.
  • I have not deleted or modified any Thunderbird profile files because I want to avoid losing existing email data.
  • The profile containing my email data appears to be “default-esr”.

I would appreciate any guidance on how to identify the cause of this issue and restore Thunderbird without losing my existing emails.

title: Occasional "The current command did not succeed. ... System Error (Failure)." errors
creator: greg_skyles
content: My email works well most of the time. About three or four times a day now I get a message "The current command did not succeed. The mail server for account <account name> responded: System Error (Failure)." Nothing seems obviously wrong that I can see, maybe some of my recipients aren't getting the emails I send? The account in question is at gmail. I've been using it, and Thunderbird, for many years without seeing this error. It seems to have popped up in the last month or two and is now happening a few times a day. I'm running Windows 11 Pro 25H2 build 26200.9168, Thunderbird 153.0.3 Build ID 20260810194242. I have plenty of disk space (1.15TB free) and restarting my system hasn't helped. Is there a way to turn on more logging to get more information about these errors?
